bullets.text: Notepad Update Rolls Out - **Microsoft** introduces table support and AI text features in **Notepad** for Windows Insiders.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - **Microsoft** releases Build 26220.7271, enhancing Xbox full screen experience for PCs.
Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader - **Microsoft** recognized as a leader in Access Management for the ninth consecutive year.
Holiday PC Buying Guide - **Microsoft** highlights Windows 11 PCs with AI features as ideal holiday gifts.
AI and Security Innovations - **Microsoft** unveils new security features and AI capabilities at Ignite 2025.
Edge for Business Launch - **Microsoft** introduces the world's first secure enterprise AI browser for enhanced productivity.
AI Agents in Workflows - **Microsoft** integrates intelligent agents into everyday security operations with **Microsoft 365 E5**.
Copilot Actions Rollout - **Microsoft** begins rolling out Copilot Actions, enabling task automation on Windows.
